svg.title: SIM onboarding: process annotations and development-case results
svg.desc: Source-preserving control-flow diagram styled for a research paper. Only r9 and r10 have supported reference correspondence. Other callouts describe unverified alarms or undetermined checks. The missing-activity box is an annotation, not a source process node.
